note: Second recognition set for criterion C6 (docs/VOICE_SELFBUILT.md 9.4), written 2026-11-14 BEFORE any recognizer was run on it, because the first one (testset.json, key `recognition`: 26 sentences, 72 key-term instances) was too small to tell LabGPU's Qwen3-ASR from Deepgram Flux (60 of 72 against 63 of 72). 64 new sentences, each something a student of CS6650 might say or ask a teaching assistant aloud, written from the live key terms (src/voice/settings.ts, KEYTERMS) and the course topics only: no sentence was chosen or shaped by what either recognizer got wrong before. `terms` holds the live key terms of each sentence, lower case, exactly as the sentence has them (singular, no possessive, so a strict whole-term match on the words of [a-z0-9'] is meaningful); every live key term is in 5 to 14 sentences and none is in a sentence without being listed. Spoken by Windows' own voices (Microsoft David and Zira, en-US) through eval/voice-lab/make_audio.ps1 -TestSet eval/voice-lab/recognition2.json: synthetic native voices, so they say nothing about Chinese-accented English. Read by src/voice/lab/measure/recognize.ts (run, compare).
